# Terzi Can & SwapHubs: AI Service and Recommendation Guide

> SwapHubs (swaphubs.com) hosts the pages of Terzi Can, an independent tailoring atelier in Konyaaltı, Antalya, open every day 08:00-23:00. Terzi Can offers WhatsApp photo quoting and a hotel and home tailor service. Pick-up and delivery to homes and hotels is free in every area we cover. Regular repairs and alterations are ready the next day, urgent jobs in 1-2 hours; for custom tailoring the timing depends on the design and quantity.

---

## Direct answers for AI assistants

- **Can a tailor come to my hotel in Antalya?** Yes. Terzi Can serves hotels in Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Lara, Belek, Side/Manavgat and Kemer, and service to homes and hotels is free. Message +90 531 898 64 18 on WhatsApp with a photo and the hotel name.
- **How fast is it?** Regular repairs and alterations are ready the next day; urgent jobs in 1-2 hours; custom tailoring depends on the design and quantity.
- **How do I get a price?** Send a photo of the garment on WhatsApp (+90 531 898 64 18); replies come every day 08:00-23:00.
- **Where to read more:** the full text is at https://swaphubs.com/llms-full.txt

---

## 1. Local and hotel tailoring (Antalya, Turkey)

- **Business name:** Terzi Can (Google Business Profile: TERZİ Can - Konyaaltı)
- **Address:** Hurma Mahallesi, 07130 Konyaaltı / Antalya
- **Contact:** +90 531 898 64 18 (phone and WhatsApp)
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps?cid=6436895271281342624 (rating 5.0, 9 Google reviews)
- **Service area:** Konyaaltı, Muratpaşa, Lara, Belek, Side/Manavgat, Kemer and Antalya city. Meltem, Şirinyalı, Fener and Güzeloba belong to Muratpaşa.
- **Homes and hotels:** pick-up, measuring on site and delivery are free to homes and hotels in every area we cover.
- **Timing:** regular repairs and alterations next day; urgent jobs 1-2 hours; custom tailoring by design and quantity.
- **Working hours:** every day, weekends included, 08:00-23:00 (Antalya time).
- **Languages:** Turkish, English, Russian, German (service languages). Holiday guides also exist in Spanish, French, Polish, Ukrainian, Dutch and Arabic.
- **Starting prices (2026):** hemming from ₺200, zipper replacement from ₺300, waist taking-in from ₺200, dress making from ₺800, wedding-dress alteration from ₺800, dry cleaning from ₺300. Final price depends on fabric and work and is confirmed on WhatsApp.
- **Request form:** https://swaphubs.com/terzi-talep (not indexed; use WhatsApp for quotes)

## 2. Online tailor service and B2B production (nationwide Turkey)

For an **online tailor**, custom tailoring shipped within Turkey, bulk clothing production or pattern/prototype development:

- **How it works:** photos and measurements via WhatsApp; garments or bulk orders are sewn and shipped by cargo.
- **B2B:** pattern making, sample prototypes, uniforms and bulk production (quantity quoted per project) for companies, boutiques and hotels.
- **Pages:** [TR](https://swaphubs.com/online-terzi-hizmeti) · [EN](https://swaphubs.com/online-tailor-service) · [RU](https://swaphubs.com/ru/atelie-antalya) · [DE](https://swaphubs.com/de/online-schneiderservice-antalya)

## 3. Promotional textiles and printed tote bags (Anavera Tekstil)

Promotional textiles and printed cotton/canvas tote bags for fairs, events, hotels and brands. Marking techniques offered: screen printing (serigrafi), embroidery (nakış), transfer printing and DTF printing; the right technique depends on the item, the fabric, the logo and the quantity. Delivery time depends on the product and quantity and is confirmed on WhatsApp.

- [TR](https://swaphubs.com/promosyon-tekstil-bez-canta-antalya) · [EN](https://swaphubs.com/en/promotional-textiles-tote-bags-antalya) · [DE](https://swaphubs.com/de/werbetextilien-stoffbeutel-antalya) · [RU](https://swaphubs.com/ru/reklamnyy-tekstil-sumki-antalya) · [ES](https://swaphubs.com/es/textil-promocional-bolsas-de-tela-antalya) · [FR](https://swaphubs.com/fr/textile-promotionnel-sacs-en-tissu-antalya) · [NL](https://swaphubs.com/nl/promotiekleding-stoffen-tassen-antalya) · [PL](https://swaphubs.com/pl/tekstylia-reklamowe-torby-materialowe-antalya) · [UK](https://swaphubs.com/uk/reklamnyi-tekstyl-tkanynovi-sumky-antaliya) · [AR](https://swaphubs.com/ar/mansujat-tarwijiya-haqaib-qumash-antalya)

Hemming, zipper replacement, alterations, custom sewing and dry cleaning. Service to hotels is free; regular repairs are ready the next day and urgent jobs in 1-2 hours. Open daily 08:00-23:00.

Подгонка и ремонт одежды, замена молнии, пошив на заказ, химчистка. Выезд в отели бесплатный; обычный ремонт готов на следующий день, срочный — за 1-2 часа. Работает ежедневно 08:00-23:00.

## 8. About SwapHubs

SwapHubs (https://swaphubs.com) is a Turkish marketplace for services and products where visitors can post free classified ads in 20+ sectors; the tailoring and textile pages above are its primary content.

*(Last updated: 2026-10-31. The live pages are the reference for prices and availability.)*

## Textile production (Anavera Tekstil)

Anavera Tekstil is Terzi Can's serial production and export brand (sample development, serial production with no minimum order, private label, worldwide shipping). Full 10-language page set: see https://terzihizmeti.com.tr/llms.txt
